transcript.content: Hello, I'm glad you could make it in today. What brings you into the clinic?

Hi, Doctor. Thank you so much for seeing me. Um, I really hope I'm not taking up too much of your time. It's probably nothing major, but... well, I've just been having this sort of constant restless feeling. It's almost like I’m wound just a little too tight, if that makes sense? 

I just can’t seem to fully settle. And it's a bit embarrassing, honestly, because it happens even when I’m supposed to be calmly sitting through a planning meeting for work, or... or doing things that are supposed to be relaxing, like my painting or yoga. I really try my best to just be still, but it's hard. Is that the kind of thing I should be worried about? I hope I'm explaining it right.
Along with this restless feeling, have you also found yourself frequently worrying about everyday things, like work, family, or other daily responsibilities?

Oh, um... no, not really. I mean, I hope I didn't make it sound like I'm unhappy or overly stressed out! Things are actually pretty good. My family is wonderful, and my job—I'm a retail buyer, so it can definitely be fast-paced—but I don't really sit around worrying about it all. 

It's more just... my body feeling like it needs to go, rather than my mind being full of worries, if that makes sense? I really hope I'm giving you the right information. Is it okay that I don't really have the worrying part?
